# Draft:Anthony Upward

Anthony Upward is a British cybersecurity practitioner and managing director of Cognition Intelligence, a UK based countersurveillance firm.
Upward was quoted by Reuters in 2022 in reporting on hacking for hire linked to litigation and arbitration disputes.
Career
Cognition Intelligence appears on the UK National Cyber Security Centre Cyber Advisor scheme pages.
Companies House records list Upward as a director of multiple UK companies, including Cyber Overwatch Limited and Overwatch Intelligence Limited.
Honours and memberships
Upward appears on a City of London list of applicants for Freedom of the City under the Worshipful Company of Fruiterers.
Fruiterers Company newsletters record Upward as elected a Freeman in 2018 and later clothed as a Liveryman in 2018.
Upward is listed as a full member of Espionage Research Institute International.
